parsed.summary: Wacky Wheels Lexington is down 2027-03-16 to 2027-03-18. 9 production orders were moved with 9 rescheduled at the same plant, 32 dealers were notified once each for 79 customer orders, and 18 loaners were assigned.
parsed.decision_reason: Acted on a confirmed plant_outage incident because ids and dates were resolved against the data, the rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and the live baseline matched before the first write.
